risk_note: B1-04zzzzj (union, RV2; FU-DATAOKE-ARCHIVEBODY-ASYNC + FU-TB-ARCHIVE-LITERAL-JSON). Behaviour-neutral refactor: (1) the three byte-identical 'parsed tree back to JSON text, numbers as literals' helpers (orders.ts rawJsonText, punishments.ts / refunds.ts literalJson) become one taobaoRawJsonText in taobao/raw-json.ts; TaobaoRawNumber moves there too (no-circular) and orders.ts re-exports it, so every instanceof check sees the same class and archived bodies are byte-identical; (2) DataokeRequestOptions.archiveBody widens to string | Promise<string> as replay.ts already declares (the archiving transport awaits it), and taobao-adapter.ts drops its widening `as` assertion and forwards archiveBody directly. No wire request, archive body, warning, error code or contract change.

reviews.note: Fresh independent Claude via claude-run.sh; pass with no findings (couli-runs/B1-04zzzzj/review-money-r1.json). The implementation is unchanged since: it was parked as impl-r1.patch while the rule tests were fixed and re-applied byte-for-byte.

spec_test_review.note: r1 pass, r2 pass (test phase 2: interface JsonTexts -> type alias for fc.letrec typing), r3 pass under approvals 114 / D10-2175 (test phase 3: literal.test.ts:42 two raw U+2028 characters written as escapes, values identical by code points). One S2 repeated in all rounds (property callback without return true; a mismatch still throws), not changed (couli-runs/B1-04zzzzj/review-spec-test-r1.json, -r2.json, -r3.json).

longrun.note: property tests use propParams(); the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
